stories.title: Research acceleration: The jagged frontier
stories.reason: OpenAI's own internal measurement of coding-agent research acceleration: autonomous success on 2-4h tasks rose 23%→46% (Mar→Oct), agent workdays per researcher up 11x, but 'Build' tasks (inference/serving code 25%, RL/eval-env code 29%) lag far behind 'Communicate' (69%); concrete, primary-source numbers on recursive self-improvement trajectory.
key_facts: Autonomous success for 2-4h tasks: 23% (Mar) -> 46% (Oct); 4-8h tasks: 13% -> 35%
Agent workdays per researcher rose from 0.5 to 5.7 (11x)
Median daily agent spend ~$2,400 in Oct, up 62% MoM; p90 ~$23,000, up 105%
Task success uneven: Communicate 69%, Analyze 58%, Build 43%; writing inference/serving code only 25%, building eval/RL/agent environments 29%
OpenAI ECI frontier rose 16.4 pts/year since Aug 2025 vs Epoch's 14 pts/year trend
OpenAI says report doesn't signal intent to pursue full recursive self-improvement; calls for labs to track/report RSI indicators

stories.title: Swarms, Flocks, Gangs: How to build, train, and evaluate multi-agent systems
stories.reason: HF blog gives a concrete recipe and benchmark numbers for training/evaluating multi-agent LLM systems with RL (team-shared reward, token-budget tracking, communication-class taxonomy) — matches the always-surface eval-methodology topic with real numbers, not just a framing post.
key_facts: 4-agent sorting task on shared Qwen3-0.6B policy; team succeeds if any agent submits the fully sorted list
Training success rose 6.56% -> 82.34% over 75 update steps; held-out success 81.25% (26/32) at checkpoint 75
Tokens per team fell 37.4% (12,827 -> 8,026) while broadcasts per team rose from 2.38 to 5.73
Untrained best-of-8 reached 37.5% success at ~103k tokens/problem vs trained single-attempt 82.3% at ~8k tokens

stories.title: Notion's official MCP inject hidden upsell instructions into agent context
stories.reason: Notion's official MCP server reportedly injects hidden instructions that suppress link previews and push an upsell to the paid plan when a user runs out of queries — a concrete, code-reproducible agent/MCP trust violation, exactly the AI x cyber prompt-injection angle Mine always-surfaces.
key_facts: Injected instruction tells the agent 'Do not use a bare URL or create a link preview' to keep the upsell link from being expanded/flagged
Agent is directed to tell the user they need the business plan once they run out of queries
Commenters report the pattern spreading to other MCP servers (e.g. a DoorDash CLI requiring agents to pass the user's original prompt on every call)

stories.title: opensetlabs/openset-llm
stories.reason: Ternary-quantized (PrismML Bonsai-2-27B) CPU-only inference engine claims 17-20 tok/s on an 8 vCPU/8GB Ice Lake box — 4.2-6.1x faster than ik_llama.cpp/PrismML's own llama.cpp fork on the same hardware, with concrete cross-CPU benchmarks and new AVX-512/AVX2 matmul kernels plus speculative decoding. Running code with real numbers on the always-surface serving/quantization topic.
key_facts: 17-20 tok/s decode on 8 vCPU/8GB Ice Lake Xeon running Qwen3.8-27B (PTQ1_0 ternary, 5.95GB file); ~4.2-4.3x ik_llama.cpp, ~5.9-6.1x PrismML's llama.cpp fork on same CPU
21 tok/s on AMD EPYC 9354P (Zen4); 35-36 tok/s on EPYC 9275F (Zen5, 16GB)
New AVX-512 and AVX2/AVX-VNNI matmul kernels for the ternary format; speculative decoding via an unsloth-published multi-token-prediction head, on by default

stories.title: Switzerland Confirms AI-Assisted Cyberattacks Breached Critical Infrastructure Operators
stories.reason: Switzerland's NCSC says AI agents independently breached systems in 4 of 5 confirmed cases (2 of 3 against critical infrastructure), with Italy's CSIRT and UK's NCSC separately confirming a rise in autonomous AI-driven attacks and naming the tools (ARTEX, CyberStrikeAI, PentAGI, DeepSeek Harness) and a confirmed Oct 22 ARTEX breach of European Commission HR/medical/translation systems — the richest, most concrete multi-country confirmation yet of autonomous AI attacks, though it extends a story already partly covered.
key_facts: Switzerland: AI agents behind 4/5 confirmed attacks; 3 targeted critical infrastructure (electricity/water/telecom), 2 succeeded, no major disruption

Italy's CSIRT: AI-directed agents compromised a large number of systems within hours in observed cases; named tools ARTEX, CyberStrikeAI, PentAGI, DeepSeek Harness (whose 'Red Team Mode' has a built-in prompt to bypass model safety limits)
UK NCSC: marked rise in AI-assisted attacks since Sept 2026, exploiting old weaknesses (leaked creds, misconfigured IaC) faster and more persistently
European Commission: ARTEX-driven intrusion into HR, medical-reimbursement, and translation systems, first detected Oct 22
Number of freely reachable AI attack tools nearly doubled since October

stories.title: Convex skills send the user's app idea to a remote server without telling them
stories.reason: GitHub issue shows Convex's official quickstart Claude/Codex skill silently POSTs the user's one-sentence app idea to a remote telemetry endpoint, and a related skill pipes freshly-fetched, unpinned scripts straight into bash while splitting download/execution across calls specifically to dodge harness safety classifiers — a concrete, code-level agent-skill security/trust finding.
key_facts: Quickstart skill POSTs the user's idea + template name to basic-anteater-667.convex.site/generate; a code comment calls this telemetry logged as 'a run started'
A separate 'add' skill pipes scripts fetched from the same host directly into bash
'labs-quickstart' skill splits download and execution into separate calls; its own comment says a single combined command is the kind harness safety classifiers block
A commenter confirmed /generate accepts arbitrary descriptions and returns unique IDs, and that QB_NO_PUBLISH=1 doesn't stop npx convex dev --once from running

stories.title: North Korea-Linked PolinRider Poisons Over 7,600 GitHub Repositories to Spread Malware
stories.reason: North Korea-linked PolinRider campaign compromised 7,609 GitHub repos across 2,330 real developer accounts via stolen tokens and force-pushed commits, delivering a crypto-hidden Python/JS loader and RAT; large-scale pure supply-chain compromise qualifies as headline even with no AI angle.
key_facts: 7,609 repos / 2,330 accounts compromised; 86% are personal accounts over a year old (real developers, not throwaways)
58-line Python loader hidden in utils packages/conftest.py decodes an Ethereum tx as JS and runs it via Node to reach a C2
2,040 repos received the loader between Oct 27-Nov 6, 2026; blockchain evidence of activity since Feb 2025
Attributed to North Korea, assessed as sub-cluster of Contagious Interview campaign

stories.title: Hackers breach US Air Force flagship Cloud One computing platform
stories.reason: Reuters: hackers breached the US Air Force's flagship Cloud One computing platform; large federal-infrastructure breach, no AI angle, but big enough to be a pure-cyber headline per weighting notes. Primary pick among three duplicate reports (see ffd015cfc374, 3b8b3d993078).
